eps.o: Chococat discovers the joy of giving when he plants his beautiful new flower garden and shares a bouquet with My Melody! But one gift sparks an idea. What if he could bring smiles to all his friends' faces with flowers of their own? As Chococat works to create the perfect bouquets for everyone, his special day becomes all about spreading happiness.

Tuxedosam can't wait to show off his favorite fashion trend: classic tuxedos! But when he asks all his friends to dress exactly like him, My Melody helps him remember what individuality really means. Soon, the runway is filled with unique styles, creative looks, and plenty of confidence. After all, being yourself is always a good look!

Chococat discovers the thrill of adventure when him and Pompompurin team up to build an amazing rocket! Super excited to blast off into the unknown, Chococat can't wait to see all the discoveries waiting for him beyond Sanrio Town. But as he prepares for launch, he realizes that one small step for Chococat is one giant leap for everyone in town and the adventure is even better when shared with…

Chococat blasts off in his spaceship on an exciting adventure beyond Sanrio Town to explore somewhere new. But when he encounters Pompompurin on his journey, everything changes. As Chococat deals with unexpected news, he discovers that his friends' support means more than he ever imagined.

When Keroppi shares his secret ramen recipe with Pochacco, one delicious bowl turns into a town-wide sensation! Soon, everyone in Sanrio Town is eager to try Keroppi's famous spiced-up ramen. But what happens when a secret recipe is no longer a secret?

Kiki and Lala are excited to race their brand new toy cars through Sanrio Town! While Kiki is focused on building the fastest car possible, the Little Twin Stars soon learn that friendship, teamwork, and enjoying the journey together matter more than crossing the finish line first.

My Melody faces off against Keroppi in five exciting challenges! With Badtz-maru watching from the sidelines, the competition heats up until Kuromi arrives to join the action. But Kuromi has other plans. Can My Melody handle the twist, or will Kuromi shake things up?

Hello Kitty, Kuromi, and My Melody visit Hangyodon's fortune cookie stand and decide to spread some positivity. As they work together to make a difference, they discover something special that being unique and different is something to celebrate.
